title: Older comparisons and complicated technology
summary: This topic centers on comparisons with older vehicles or features, with one clear positive note on comfort and interest and one clear negative note about technology feeling too complicated, while most fragments lack enough context for a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review says the vehicle feels more comfortable and more interesting than an older one.

negative.summary: The negative review says the vehicle’s technology feels too complicated for an older customer to use comfortably.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mostly mention older vehicles, firm older seats, or interesting-sounding modes without enough context to identify clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or incomplete to support confident sentiment interpretation.
